title: OpenAuriUsb Capacitor bridge, bridgeApi 1
description: Payloads of the native Android plugin OpenAuriUsb (plan Anexo B and C). Each method M has $defs MRequest (the options the page passes) and MResponse (what the promise fulfils with); every rejection is an Error; the events connect and disconnect carry ConnectEvent and DisconnectEvent. Validate a payload against one definition, e.g. https://open-auri.com/schemas/android-usb-bridge-1.schema.json#/$defs/GetInfoResponse. The native side validates every response and event of its tests with this file (BridgeSchemaTest).

Hex.description: Bytes as lower-case hex, two digits per byte, no separators.

KeyArgument.description: A device key as the page passes it back. Any non-empty string is accepted; an unknown one is rejected with USB_NOT_FOUND.

NativeDeviceInfo.description: A device as the plugin reports it. key is deviceName#n: valid while the device stays attached; a reconnection always yields a new key.

productName.description: The USB product string; empty when the device has none.

NoOptions.description: Options of a method without parameters (Capacitor sends {}).

VoidResponse.description: The method resolves without a payload: the promise fulfils with undefined. Validated here as JSON null.

UsbFilter.description: Matches devices by vendor and product ID; a missing member matches any value.

webViewVersion.description: Version name of the active WebView provider, or unknown.

liveApply.description: Optional; true when the native write guard accepts live (uncommitted) applies: in AwaitCommit, a valid data report 0 abandons the uncommitted sequence and starts the next one (plan Anexo D.3). Absent in older app versions, which must be treated as false.

RequestDeviceRequest.description: Filters are intersected with CB5100 (VID 0x3302, PID 0x8902). An empty array or an empty filter object means CB5100 only; other vendor/product identities match nothing.

RequestDeviceResponse.description: The devices the user granted; empty when nothing matched, the user cancelled or denied.

GetDevicesResponse.description: The attached CB5100 cables (VID 0x3302, PID 0x8902) the app has permission for.

data.description: The report data without the report ID, in standard base64 (RFC 4648, padding optional).

UsbDiagnostics.description: The USB diagnostics of an open device (RF8). wireLog is present only in debug builds of the app (RS7).

endpoints.description: Endpoints of the HID interface. A conforming HID interface only has interrupt endpoints; isochronous is listed so a malformed device is still reported.

paddedLength.description: Length of every output buffer on the wire: the largest output report plus the report ID byte (WINDOWS_MAX_OUTPUT).

wireLog.description: Debug builds only: the last buffers sent, oldest first, with the monotonic time in ms.

ConnectEvent.description: A CB5100 cable was plugged in. It gets a new key; the app may still need permission (requestDevice).

DisconnectEvent.description: A device with a key was unplugged; the key is no longer valid. Sent before the rejection of any call pending on it.

Error.description: Every rejection of the plugin: Capacitor's error object with a code of ErrorCode.
